checks.title: PDF file format mismatch
checks.description: Extension does not match detected PDF/magic format.

checks.title: Unrecognized PDF signature
checks.description: Could not confirm PDF magic bytes for the claimed extension.

checks.title: PDF file integrity
checks.description: SHA-256 computed; PDF format signature looks consistent.

checks.title: PDF metadata unavailable
checks.description: Could not read PDF Info dictionary (may be image-only, encrypted, or non-PDF).

checks.title: PDF modified after creation
checks.description: Modified Date is later than Creation Date — may indicate post-creation edits.

checks.title: PDF dates consistent
checks.description: Creation/Modified dates do not show a clear post-edit gap.

checks.title: Unusual PDF producer/creator
checks.description: Producer/Creator looks like an editor or print driver, not a typical HR/payroll exporter.

checks.title: PDF producer recorded
checks.description: Producer/Creator metadata was recorded for review.

checks.title: PDF producer missing
checks.description: Producer/Creator metadata is empty — common after stripping or reconstruction.

checks.title: PDF incremental update / re-save
checks.description: Multiple %%EOF or /Prev xref — PDF was edited or annotated after creation.

checks.title: PDF annotations / marks detected
checks.description: Ink, highlight, free-text, stamp, or redact annotations overlay the page.

checks.title: Visual tampering detected
checks.description: Model saw marks, whiteout, erased/overwritten text, or similar edits on the PDF.

checks.title: Earnings total mismatch
checks.description: Sum of earnings line items does not match total earnings.

checks.title: Deductions total mismatch
checks.description: Sum of deduction line items does not match total deductions.

checks.title: Net salary math mismatch
checks.description: Gross − deductions does not match net salary.

checks.title: Salary math consistent
checks.description: Gross − deductions matches net salary within tolerance.

checks.title: Salary math not fully checkable
checks.description: Not enough numeric fields to validate earnings/deductions/net.

checks.title: Bank balance mismatch
checks.description: Opening + credits − debits does not match closing balance.

checks.title: Bank balance consistent
checks.description: Opening + credits − debits matches closing balance.

checks.title: Payslip layout / amount gap
checks.description: Earning line label present but amount blank while totals exist — possible edit or alignment tampering.

checks.title: Image format mismatch
checks.description: Extension does not match detected image magic format (JPEG/PNG/WEBP/etc).

checks.title: Unrecognized image signature
checks.description: Could not confirm image magic bytes for the claimed extension.

checks.title: Image file integrity
checks.description: SHA-256 computed; image format signature looks consistent.

checks.title: Image type recorded
checks.description: Detected image type from magic bytes / extension.

checks.title: Image file too small
checks.description: Image payload is unusually small and may be incomplete or placeholder.

checks.title: Image edit residual anomaly (ELA)
checks.description: Error-level analysis found uneven residuals typical of local edits, marks, or pasted regions.

checks.title: Image contains editor signatures
checks.description: Binary/metadata fingerprints of Photoshop, Paint, GIMP, Canva, etc.

checks.title: Image editor metadata found
